$comment: CLIENT-side MCP configuration. Copy into your assistant's config.
The point of this file: `browser_run_code_unsafe` ships in the DEFAULT tool set
of @playwright/mcp 0.0.80, under 'Core automation', with no capability to enable.
Its own description reads: 'Unsafe: executes arbitrary JavaScript in the
Playwright server process and is RCE-equivalent.'
And the server offers NO command-line option to exclude an individual tool:
`--caps` only ADDS capabilities. Reducing the tool surface is therefore the
CLIENT's responsibility, through the `tools` allowlist below. Hardening the
server does not remove the tool.
Before using this file, create ai-engineering/policy/secrets.env from secrets.env.example,
start the SUT so the qa-ai-optional-sut-internal network exists, and replace
ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_REPO below: bind mounts are resolved against the MCP client's
working directory, which is not necessarily the repository root.
Verified 2026-09-07 against @playwright/mcp 0.0.80. Re-check on every upgrade:
the default tool set is an implementation detail.

$comment_tools: EXPLICIT allowlist. Any tool absent from this list is unavailable.
A denylist would be wrong by construction: a tool added by a future version
would arrive enabled. Here it arrives disabled.
browser_install          writes outside the read-only mounts
